uncited: This family encompasses methods that improve NeRF training stability against adversarial perturbations [Aug-NeRF](10294-aug-nerf.md), novel view synthesis quality through ensemble compression [NeRF Ensemble with Conjoint Pruning](12608-nerf-ensemble-with-conjoint-pruning.md), and handling of unconstrained "in-the-wild" data with transient occluders or synthetic-to-real domain gaps [NeRF in the Wild](13541-nerf-in-the-wild.md), [ContraNeRF](13659-contranerf.md).

**Implicit Regularization:** Methods like [Aug-NeRF](10294-aug-nerf.md) inject worst-case perturbations during training to smooth the loss landscape, avoiding the over-constraining of explicit smoothness regularizers.

**Ensemble and Compression:** Methods like [NeRF Ensemble with Conjoint Pruning](12608-nerf-ensemble-with-conjoint-pruning.md) combine multiple models of different resolutions and compress them to reduce variance and memory footprint while maintaining quality.

**Disentanglement:** Methods like [NeRF in the Wild](13541-nerf-in-the-wild.md) separate the scene into static geometry and image-dependent transient/appearance components to handle non-static elements.

**Cross-View Consistency:** Methods like [ContraNeRF](13659-contranerf.md) use contrastive learning and geometry-aware feature aggregation to ensure multi-view consistency without per-scene optimization.
